content.text:
The MP response already contains enough data for a ranked list of funders without a new API request. Each declaration contains entries with nullable funder identity, exact decimal amount, currency and payment type. There is no precomputed MP-by-funder aggregate.

- [`MemberSummary.svelte:45`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/MemberSummary.svelte:45) renders the earnings timeline beside the category breakdown. [`member-summary.ts:23`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/member-summary.ts:23) derives its model. It currently selects four normalized employment category labels, then groups their entries by registration month. Replacing this slot need not affect the category breakdown, recent declarations or headline totals.
- [`entity-details.ts:47`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/entity-details.ts:47) defines `FundingEntry` and `MemberDeclaration`. Group sources by funder ID, not name. Multiple entries and declarations can identify the same funder. Funder can be null, so the replacement needs an explicit unavailable-source treatment. [`MemberDeclarations.svelte:47`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/MemberDeclarations.svelte:47) already shows linked funder names and “Funder unavailable”.
- [`+page.server.ts:23`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/routes/[...path]/+page.server.ts:23) loads the Rust response server-side. [`server/entity-details.ts:88`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/server/entity-details.ts:88) parses every declaration and preserves amount strings, nulls and funder identities. No API schema change is needed for a frontend-derived source ranking.
- [`sum-amounts.ts:1`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/sum-amounts.ts:1) sums arbitrary precision decimals with scaled `BigInt`; empty input returns null. [`entity-details.ts:167`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/entity-details.ts:167) supplies exact signed bar ratios, converting only bounded display ratios to `Number`. `formatPounds` preserves all decimal digits and distinguishes null from zero. Ranking requires an equally exact comparator, rather than `Number(amount)`.
- [`registration-timeline.ts:9`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/registration-timeline.ts:9) currently includes GBP and unknown-currency entries, excludes known foreign currencies, marks missing GBP amounts or unknown currency as incomplete, and excludes undated declarations. Its month buckets include zero-valued gaps and negative amounts. It remains used for funder funding, so replacing the MP chart should not delete this helper or shared timeline component.

Backend totals remain authoritative. [`entity_details.rs:76`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_details.rs:76) aggregates every category, including unknown IDs, with `BigDecimal`. Historical totals include undated declarations. Current-term totals include registration timestamps on or after `2024-07-09T00:00:00Z`. Missing GBP amounts and unknown currency mark GBP totals incomplete; known foreign currencies do not. Counts are declaration counts, including declarations without monetary entries. [`member-summary.ts:34`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/member-summary.ts:34) passes those totals through unchanged.

A ranked source list therefore needs a stated scope. Aggregating all declaration categories and including undated records would describe historical sources of declared amounts; retaining the earnings filter and dated-only rule would describe a narrower population. The UI should call these “declared amounts”, and should not imply earnings or reconcile its own subset back into the backend headline totals.

Tests affected:

- [`member-summary.spec.ts:70`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/tests/member-summary.spec.ts:70) currently tests MP earnings aggregation, exact duplicates, negatives, zero, nulls, unknown currencies and employment label classification. Replace MP-specific expectations with source grouping, exact ranking, ties, missing identities, mixed currencies and selected date/category scope. Preserve shared timeline coverage.
- [`member-summary.spec.ts:309`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/tests/member-summary.spec.ts:309) verifies backend headline independence. Preserve this guard.
- [`entity-details.spec.ts:123`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/tests/entity-details.spec.ts:123), [`entity-details.spec.ts:1022`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/tests/entity-details.spec.ts:1022) and [`entity-details.spec.ts:1379`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/tests/entity-details.spec.ts:1379) assert MP chart labels and bars. Update these for source order, displayed exact amounts and funder navigation. Funder timeline assertions at line 231 should remain.
- Shared bar-chart gallery tests in [`design-system.spec.ts:191`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/tests/design-system.spec.ts:191) remain relevant unless the shared component itself changes.

No files were changed.
